subject.title: fix: recover updater from late launchd bootout errors

question: Should the canonical launchd stop-proof retry land from this focused PR, or be consolidated into the broader proof-positive https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105022?
rationale: Both open branches edit the same availability-sensitive updater state machine with different retry windows and filtering, while the sibling also carries a separate useful plist repair; repository evidence cannot choose the integration owner without maintainer intent.

options.title: Land focused retry first
options.body: Add exact-head macOS proof here, merge this narrower authoritative-proof implementation, then remove the duplicate retry loop from the sibling before reviewing its plist repair.

options.title: Consolidate into sibling
options.body: Port this branch's typed transient-error and launchd-proof filtering into the sibling, retain its live proof and plist repair, and close this PR after validating the consolidated head.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Keep both open until a maintainer selects the retry duration and combined updater state machine.

recommendation.title: Land focused retry first
recommendation.body: Add exact-head macOS proof here, merge this narrower authoritative-proof implementation, then remove the duplicate retry loop from the sibling before reviewing its plist repair.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged feature history and both competing branch implementations are connected to this contributor, who is also the current assignee.
